store.description: Disc golf pro shop in Murray, Utah (Salt Lake City area): new and used discs, bags, baskets, carts, apparel, plus Magic: The Gathering and Pokemon.

products.title: Z Swirl Buzzz SS - Ezra Robinson 2025 Tour Series
products.description: The Discraft Buzzz SS is the younger and less stable brother of the Buzzz. The Buzzz SS is a midrange that is great for straight and turnover shots and packs some serious glide. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Ezra Robinson edition stamp and showcases Ezra as a member of Discraft's Elite Team — Speed 5 | Glide 4 | Turn -2 | Fade 1.

products.title: Z Swirl Drive - Paige Pierce 2025 Tour Series
products.description: Elevate your game with the Discraft Drive, the latest addition in Paige Pierce's lineup of discs. With a balance of precision and glide, the Drive slots between the Zeus and the Surge SS. Whether you’re driving down tight fairways or navigating the skies in open fields, the Drive offers a blend of control and power that will take your throws further. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Paige Pierce edition stamp and showcases Paige as a member of Discraft's Elite Team — Speed 11 | Glide 5 | Turn -1 | Fade 2.

products.title: Z Swirl Force - Ricky Wysocki 2025 Tour Series
products.description: The Force is great for both backhand and forehand shots and is perfect for any wind condition. The Force is a 12 speed, overstable driver that is a staple in Discraft's lineup. The Force is the go to driver for many top Discraft pros. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Ricky Wysocki edition stamp and showcases Ricky as a member of Discraft's Elite Team — Speed 12 | Glide 5 | Turn 0 | Fade 3.

products.title: Z Swirl Luna - Paul McBeth 2025 Tour Series
products.description: Luna. A disc that brings consistency to your game. The Luna was the first mold in the Paul McBeth line of discs and is the preferred putter of the 6X World Champion. Known for its remarkable glide, it's the disc of choice for downhill shots and putts from anywhere on the green. The Luna is a straight flyer, holding the line you set for it. It's torque resistant and although it may feel a bit deeper than other putters, users find it comfortable to grip. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Paul McBeth edition stamp and showcases Paul as a member of Discraft's Elite Team.

products.title: Z Swirl Scorch - Valerie Mandujano 2025 Tour Series
products.description: The Scorch is a mix between a Heat and an Avenger SS. The Scorch is an 11 speed, understable driver that provides a consistent flight and the ability for big throws. The Scorch is ideal for hyzer flip shots in the woods or tailwind drives. Blaze past the competition with the Scorch! This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Valerie Mandujano edition stamp and showcases Valerie as a member of Discraft's Elite Team.

products.title: Z Swirl Swarm - Andrew Presnell 2025 Tour Series
products.description: The Swarm is reliably overstable and has been described as a longer Zone. Handling any kind of wind, this disc is torque resistant and has a reliable fade. Fitting the gap between a Zone and Captain's Raptor, this utility disc is perfect for approach shots under 250'. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Andrew Presnell edition stamp and showcases Andrew as a member of Discraft's Elite Team.

products.title: Z Swirl Thrasher - Missy Gannon 2025 Tour Series
products.description: Missy Gannon’s Thrasher has always balanced speed and understability, but the Z Swirl version feels firmer with a bit more bite at the end of its flight. It’s a perfect go-to for hyzer flips and long turnovers that stick the landing.

products.title: Z Swirl Venom - Anthony Barela 2025 Tour Series
products.description: Big-arms revel at the ultimate, stable distance driver: the Discraft Venom. The Venom can be described as a longer, faster Force, while still maintaining the same feel in the hand. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Anthony Barela edition stamp and showcases Anthony as a member of Discraft's Elite Team — Speed 13 | Glide 5 | Turn 0 | Fade 3.

products.title: Z Swirl Vulture -Holyn Handley 2025 Tour Series
products.description: The Vulture by Discraft is known for its long-range placement and controllable flight characteristics. This disc is appreciated for its less stable flight compared to some other drivers, offering more glide, and it's recognized for being a reliable choice especially when precision is required on the course. The Vulture is ideal for players who need a disc that offers consistent performance, aligning well with Holyn Handley's powerful throws and her strategic approach to the game. This 2025 Tour Series run in Z Swirl plastic comes with this Holyn Handley edition stamp and showcases Holyn as a member of Discraft's Elite Team.

products.title: Champion Proto Glow Teebird - Jen Allen
products.description: The Innova TeeBird in Champion Proto Glow plastic (Jen Allen). This fairway driver is stable, built for laser-straight lines with a reliable finish, plus a gentle, predictable finish — great for straight shots with a late finish. Speed 7 | Glide 5 | Turn 0 | Fade 2.

products.title: Star Destroyer - Philo Brathwaite 2025 TS
products.description: The Innova Destroyer in Star plastic (Philo Brathwaite 2025 TS). A stable distance driver that brings straight pushes with subtle turn, plus a strong, dependable fade — excellent for controlled distance with a consistent finish. Speed 12 | Glide 5 | Turn -1 | Fade 3.

products.title: Max Disctance XF10 Carbon Fiber Retriever
products.description: This is the all new top of the line carbon fiber Max Stick. It features a 10ft telescoping pole with one of our patent pending max stick attachments. This pole is made with a thick layer of carbon fiber (.5mm) greatly increasing the strength of the pole making it one of the most durable retrievers on the market. The attachment is slightly smaller than what the current max stick uses (34 Suction cups vs 42). This allows for less stress on the retriever when it is stored or laid on its side, but still has the same amazing result when retrieving your disc. The Max Stick CF also features a S clip feature to prevent your pole from extending on its own accidentally. This will help reduce accidental damage to your Max Stick CF while you’re out on the course, while in storage, or during transportation. Finally, the greatest feature of the Max Stick CF, every section of this retriever is replaceable. If you manage to break any section of this retriever we offer replacement parts for a reasonable price, making this the last telescoping retriever you will ever have to buy.

products.description: THE CRAVE IS A STRAIGHT-STABLE FAIRWAY DRIVER. Axiom’s first Fission™ disc is here with the Fission™ Crave! Available in weights all the way down to 155g, the Fission™ Crave is an ideal fairway driver for all arm speeds. Hit your lines with confidence with a Fission™ Crave! The popular “worn workhorse-stable” vibe is achieved with subtle wing contours that also feel great in the hand. With flight numbers of 11 | 5 | -1.5 | 3, the Defy in Fission plastic is slightly less stable, making it a great choice for easy but reliable distance for all arm speeds. The Fission Defy will still remain the line-locking, forward-finishing driver it’s expected to be, but now - thanks to it being available in lighter weights - more players can enjoy it! Experience the benefits of Fission technology for yourself, and try the Fission Defy today!

products.description: The defining characteristic of the Crave is its straight flight and long forward fade. The Crave responds to power for a bit extra distance and gentle turn at high speed. Its total line is one of the most “locked-on” of the GYRO® enhanced drivers. During its finishing stage of flight, the Crave exhibits a particularly forward drop. It is best suited to long straight neutral-stable shots.

products.title: Proton Envy
products.description: The Axiom Envy in Proton plastic. Built as a stable putter for laser-straight lines with a reliable finish, plus a gentle, predictable finish with a control-first feel — great for straight shots with a late finish. Speed 3 | Glide 3 | Turn 0 | Fade 2.

products.title: Proton Fireball
products.description: The defining characteristic of the Fireball’s flight is its wind and power resistance. This coupled with a delayed and focused fade make the Fireball a unique addition to the GYRO® bag. It can function as a longer-pushing Motion or a more overstable Tesla. High power throwers will get a fairly turn-free high-speed stage that seems to hold a bit longer before fading, making the Fireball useful for long pan-outs, straight power shots, and sweeping hyzers. Average power throwers will get significant headwind resistance and see more easily workable lines than with the Motion. The Fireball is equally suited to backhands and forehands. Its high-speed stability allows for line-locking power shots, and its late fade helps range the disc for optimal course placement.

products.title: Proton Insanity
products.description: The Insanity is one of the most popular discs in the Axiom lineup. Axiom is known for their Gyro technology, featuring overloads on all of their discs. This Insanity disc is a super glidey understable driver that’s useable for all skill levels. Pro players will find the mold is great for rollers and massive turnover shots, while beginners will find this disc to be one of their main drivers. One of the first discs we like to offer people when first starting out, these things feel great in the hand and really have a nice flight. We think lots of people could benefit from throwing these, try out the Axiom Proton Insanity disc and see for yourself.

Proton Soft is a plastic type that the Proxy is not run in often, and the swirly rims on these discs have to be seen to be believed. Speed 5 | Glide 5 | Turn -1 | Fade 1.

products.title: Total Eclipse Pitch - Commemorative Edition
products.description: Release Date: April 5, 2024. Celebrate the April 8th Total Solar Eclipse with the first release of the Axiom Pitch! Matthew Jorde commemorates this moment, a 4 minute long eclipse of the sun, on our delightfully colorful Total Eclipse plastic. Featuring color glow cores and rims, the Total Eclipse Pitch is the perfect way to celebrate when the lights go out. Similar to its immensely popular cousin, the MVP Glitch, the Axiom Pitch is a hybrid catch disc - intended to provide a fun way to warm up, while being a uniquely glidey approach disc all on its own. Coming in with flight numbers of 1 | 7 | -0.5 | 0, the Pitch features a refined wing and slightly more rounded hand feel compared to the Glitch, making the Pitch just a bit less stable while maintaining the glide you expect from it. With cores and rims available in Green, Blue, Purple, Teal, and White color glow, get yours before the chance has eclipsed! Note: Due to the vibrant color cores and rims, Total Eclipse Color glow takes slightly longer to charge, and glows with slightly less intensity than our normal Eclipse plastic. As always, please use dedicated UV light sources for best results.

High-speed turn and a forward fading finish set the Proxy up to be an incredibly versatile disc for shot shaping through wooded holes, around corners, or just laser straight shots. Now available any time of the year in the color glow cores and rims of Total Eclipse plastic - Green, Blue, Purple, Teal, and White - you can reliably add the Proxy to your bag for day or night. Experience one of the most versatile putters in the MVP family by grabbing your own Total Eclipse Proxy!

We have a crew of Howler Monkeys that test our bags harder than you'll ever use it. We've thrown it at trees, down hills, run over it with cars, slammed it in the baskets, and drug it through mud. Notice the side pockets. We raised them up, away from the bag bottom so they don't drag on the ground and wear around the edges like other bags. Plus, we added some of those tiny little feet that really work well on a bag this size. They keep the bag upright (most of the time) because its no fun when your bag falls over. You can easily carry 12 discs in the Crunch Box bag, a jacket, a liter of water, your wallet, car keys and one small Howler Monkey. The padded shoulder strap will keep it comfortable. The FADE Lite has the basic set of features; 2-putter pocket, beverage pocket, pencil and scorecard pockets. One big feature is a comfortable shoulder strap. You can load this bag up with as much weight as other everyday bags so it might as well be comfortable. The main compartment is divided into two sections and will hold 10-12 discs, plus you can store two putters in this puppy. The FADE Lite is made from durable 600-D Polyester canvas. We double-stitch the seams and cover them with tape to prevent unraveling. Stress points are reinforced.

products.title: S-Line CD1
products.description: CD1 is back with a reinvented name in our grippy and durable S-Line plastic. Formerly known as CD2, we’ve brought the mold back to the spotlight based on popular demand. The letters “CD” in the name stand for Control Driver, putting the player in the driver’s seat and allowing you full control to manipulate and style the disc exactly how you want it to. CD1 makes for a great first distance driver for less powerful or skilled players and an incredibly useful disc for experts, too. Those with a bit more arm speed will find that this disc often will compete for distance with even their fastest drivers, yet the execution feels more effortless and controlled. Compared to the C-Line counterpart, this S-Line version is going to fly a bit straighter with less effort. Profile of the disc is comparable with a gentle dome throughout and semi rigid flexibility. CD1 handles just about any wind condition with ease but is most well suited for tailwinds and calmer weather. Players will notice that the CD1 has the tendency to fly similarly to a well seasoned PD, giving you the right amount of glide and shot shaping options but will always maintain enough stability to end with a smooth low speed fade in the end. If you only had one disc to play a round with, this disc would be an excellent choice.

products.title: S-Line CD1 (Retired Thunder)
products.description: The legend returns! What started as somewhat of an inside joke has officially become a reality with the last installment of the Roaming Thunder in the form of none other than Retired Thunder. Don't let the coconut and the beach chair fool you, though, Dana whoops our staff up and down the course with ease to this day and don't you dare challenge him to a game of knockout on the court. Note: This disc won't grant you the usual senior discounts like Dana gets at IHOP or Applebees but you can certainly give it a shot! CD1 is back with a reinvented name in our grippy and durable S-Line plastic. Formerly known as CD2, we've brought the mold back to the spotlight based on popular demand. The letters "CD" in the name stand for Control Driver, putting the player in the driver's seat and allowing you full control to manipulate and style the disc exactly how you want it to. CD1 makes for a great first distance driver for less powerful or skilled players and an incredibly useful disc for experts, too. Those with a bit more arm speed will find that this disc often will compete for distance with even their fastest drivers, yet the execution feels more effortless and controlled. CD1 handles just about any wind condition with ease but is most well suited for tailwinds and calmer weather. Players will notice that the CD1 has the tendency to fly similarly to a well seasoned PD, giving you the right amount of glide and shot shaping options but will always maintain enough stability to end with a smooth low speed fade in the end. If you only had one disc to play a round with, this disc would be an excellent choice. Good for: Backhand, forehand, tailwind, calm weather, amateur distance driver, expert fairway/distance driver, sneaky sneaky bombs.

products.title: S-Line DD
products.description: The Discmania DD (Hysteria, Distance Driver) (S-Line). This is the DD, our most understable Originals Distance Driver - Reinvented. Step aside, it’s time to add some glide! An exciting addition to the Originals line ushers in a new era for long distance shots with the S-Line DD. As the name implies, DD stands for “distance driver” and that’s exactly what it’s going to offer. It provides the distance option when you really want to uncork one but still makes you feel like you’re throwing a controllable fairway driver and will be very complimentary to the other distance drivers in your bag. The only compliment it might not give you is on how you dress for the day but that’s about it. A beginner or advanced player is going to pick one up right away and notice a drastic change in the distance added to their game with a DD. Higher skilled players will use these for max distance and controlled lines with shot shaping abilities. Legend has it some are still flying to this day. Got a big tailwind? Reach for this one ASAP. Anything else is up to you. DD will fight for the top slot in your bag day in and day out.

products.title: S-Line DD1
products.description: This is the DD1, our answer to controlled distance for the masses. The DD1 is cited to be DD3’s little brother, the DD1 features a less overstable and more narrow flight path compared to our most popular distance driver, the DD3. DD1 is famous for its straight and accurate flight, makes it a great tool in the woods. Players will fall in love with the DD1 feel and profile, plus a smaller rim compared to DD3 gives you that extra confidence when facing the tight fairway and nice dome gives you the optimal amount of glide to still get big distance. The DD1 is a great choice to build your distance game, as its high glide, narrow flight path and comfortable grip ensures it’s the one disc you’ll reach for over and over again.

products.title: S-Line DD3
products.description: The Discmania DD3 (Cloud Breaker, Distance Driver) (S-Line). The DD3 is a stable to overstable distance driver that offers a ton of glide for players who are able to get this disc up to speed. The DD3 crushes down the fairway with enough stability to handle pro level power without turning over and enough glide to give the disc a full flight. The stability of the DD3 also makes it an excellent choice for anyone looking to get the most out of their forehands. Fans of beat in PD2’s will find a reliable replacement out of the box with the DD3. The DD3 is perfect for pro players who are looking to expand the limits of what a distance driver can do, or any player looking for a reliably stable driver in their bag. Connor Mitts says, “The DD3 reinvented the way I think about distance shots. Whether I’m throwing backhand or sidearm, the DD3 gives me confidence looking down the fairway. The mold offers an incredible culmination of speed, glide, and semi-overstable stability. It has helped me add significant range to my distance game without sacrificing control. I would recommend the DD3 to a wide range of skill levels since there are many different uses for the disc.”.

products.title: S-Line FD1
products.description: The FD1 is a brand new disc to our Originals disc line and it’s designed to fill the gap between our two icons FD and FD3. Stable flight with dependable fade in the end is a true combo for accuracy when you want to hit the fairways. It will have some similarities to that of a C-line FD when you pick it up but the glide has been stepped down a notch and low speed fade added as well to add more stability for windy situations and accuracy. Players will fall in love with the FD1 relatively flat profile and smooth release on backhand and sidearm shots. Compared to the C-Line counterpart, the S-Line version will fly noticeably straighter in the air with less effort. It will still handle plenty of windy situations and finish on reliable hyzer angles but will give you the laser beam straight shots that you’ve been craving since the release of FD1. Pair the two of these together and you’ll have plenty of options available for whatever the course throws your way, and what you throw at it in return. FD1 has a very high tolerance for speed and torque, meaning it can be thrown hard and is able to push forward on a straight and consistent flight path while finishing with a soft bite at the end. It’s got enough over stability to handle plenty of wind, forced turnover shots, and a wide variety of powerful shot shaping angles while maintaining a more throwable feel like a less stable disc normally would. You can rely on it to get you out of trouble, navigate tricky fairways, and conquer all conditions on any given day.

products.title: S-Line FD3
products.description: The Discmania FD3 (Fairway Driver) (S-Line). The FD3 is our true workhorse fairway driver. Featuring a low profile, blunt nose, and concave inner rim, this is the disc to get things done. It can be trusted to handle high amounts of wind, forehand shots, thumber/tomahawk, and snappy backhand throws from even the strongest arms. Every player needs one of these in the bag for its sheer reliability and durability. Out of all the highly requested molds to be reintroduced back into the market, this one is certainly near the top of the charts. Our Reinvented FD3 packs just as much of a punch as its C-Line counterpart and will give you that familiar, grippy S-Line feel. Profile-wise, this FD3 just the slightest amount of dome, providing the right amount of glide while keeping the beefy finish that the FD3 is known for.

products.title: S-Line P3x
products.description: The Discmania P3x (new) (S-Line). Release Date: April 10, 2024 The P3x is another one of our true workhorse putters similar to a P2, yet we spiced it up a bit. For players that love the P2 but find it too deep to latch on to, the P3x is the one for you. It features a large bead on the bottom, board flat profile, and a slightly smaller interior rim to ensure a clean release every time. They are perfect for any windy day on the course, smooth reliable upshots, big hyzers, or power forehand/backhand throws that will travel on a rope and get you a clean fade that you can count on. Don't miss out on one of our most awaited releases, you won't be disappointed! What’s it used for? S-Line putters are generally preferred away from the putting surface, meaning you’ll want to lean on it for shorter holes off the tee, approaches to the green, and utility shots throughout the fairways. But if putting with S-Line is your jam, we got the jelly! About this S-Line release: Compared to the recently released Color Glow version that was reintroduced in Winter 2023 Mystery Boxes, these are going to feel noticeably thinner in your hand and will fly with a bit more over-stability, too! We’re very pleased with how torque resistant this stock run is and have the feeling it’s going to be competing for a bag slot with the even fondest of Tactic lovers out there.

products.title: S-Line PD
products.description: The PD is a power driver, designed to offer control and a reliable flight path in all conditions. It’s possibly the best all-around driver for more advanced players. Newer players will also find use for the PD as a trusty overstable disc for headwind throws and flex shots. The PD is a fantastic choice for both backhand and forehand throws when extra accuracy is called for!

products.title: S-Line PD2
products.description: The Discmania PD2 (Chaos, Power Driver) (S-Line). A PD2 is a tool, a weapon, an ally, an enemy. It’s a force to be reckoned with, powering down fairways and slicing through windy elements with ease. Created with more advanced to expert players in mind, these powerful discs are made to withstand tremendous amounts of snap and arm speed in order to get it to peak performance. Players of all calibers do enjoy this disc, though. You’ll find it especially handy for windy situations, forehand, overhand, and extremely reliable backhand hyzer shots. We don’t recommend this disc if you’re buying your first product to learn to play but other than that, we recommend all players carry something like this in their bags. Pro Tip: For those of you that have thrown the Mystery Box version (Sky Stone), these are going to be a little bit flatter than most of those and slightly more gummy. Flight-wise, very similar.

products.description: The Discmania FD (Jackal, Fairway Driver) (Show Stopper 2). This is the FD, our most popular fairway driver - Reinvented. The FD was our first Fairway Driver and has always been a true best seller in our line up. It’s certainly one of the most iconic Discmania molds out there. If you’re looking to get your hands on your first Discmania disc, this is a great place to start. Famous for its extremely straight flight path combined with high glide and controllability, the FD has a place in everyone’s bag. New players will fall in love with the FD’s straight-to-stable flight path and dependability off the tee. For players with some experience, the FD offers point-and-shoot accuracy that connects you with your target at ease. The FD is a great foundation to build your bag around, as its versatility ensures it’s the one disc you’ll reach for over and over again in various situations. Don’t let the speed rating fool you, the FD glides surprisingly far! If you are having trouble hitting the fairway with max speed drivers, take a step back, let the glide take you there, and the straight flight will place you in the middle of the fairway. The C-line version tends to settle on the more overstable end of the FD spectrum, meaning it can handle a lot of power while maintaining a straight flight path.

products.title: Zeta's Moon - Colten Montgomery Signature Series Special Blend S-Line CD1
products.description: As the Howls fade in the distance, a new predator emerges. Zeta Wolf, also referred to as “King of the Wolves” conquers all in its wake, leaving no trace nor birdies behind. Colten Montgomery gets a fierce addition in the Discmania Signature Series line with the debut of the Zeta’s Moon CD1. This marks the first signature version of this famous reinvented mold. Long time Discmaniacs used to the old CD2 should be right at home with Zeta’s Moon. Grippy Special Blend material brings a bit straighter flight and flexible feel versus the C-Line counterpart. CD1 handles just about any wind condition with ease but is most well suited for tailwinds and calmer weather. CD1 tends to fly similar to a well seasoned PD, giving you just the right amount of glide and shot shaping options, but will always maintain enough stability to end with a smooth low speed fade. If you only had one disc to play a round with, this disc would be an excellent choice.

products.title: Prototype ESP Ares
products.description: What began as the highly talked-about Zeus 2.0, has officially evolved into Ares, a distance driver built for players who wanted more torque resistance from a Zeus without losing the feel and shot shaping capabilities. Early test flight runs quickly became a coveted release among both pros and everyday players. This disc is celebrated for the added stability, powerful end flight finish, and ability to push forward without drifting from its line. Now, that momentum becomes official. The Ares keeps the familiar hand feel and high-speed profile players loved in the Zeus, but brings a more overstable, torque-resistant flight built for bigger arms, tough conditions, and max distance shots. This is the kind of disc players reach for when they want to throw aggressively without sacrificing reliability. Whether launched on a flex line or driven flat with power, the Ares is built to push forward and finish with authority. While Zeus sparked the question, Ares answers it.

products.description: This is a fast stable driver that can handle full power throws and moderate headwinds. Advanced players and sidearm throwers will appreciate the dependable stability. products.title: Star Caiman
products.description: Drawing inspiration from the Gator, the Caiman muscles its way into Innova’s mid-range lineup with a strong fade and minimal glide—the Caiman thrives in a headwind. products.title: Star Charger
products.description: The Charger is a straight-finishing, 13-speed driver that can be thrown at full power without worrying about the disc flipping over. The Charger fills a gap between the Destroyer and the Shryke. For players looking for the consistency of the Destroyer with less fade, try the Charger. For those looking for the big distance of the Shryke, but in a disc that can better handle the wind, try the Charger.

products.title: Star Colossus
products.description: The Colossus is a max distance driver with predictable high speed turn and reliable fade. Although it has a wide rim, it is also relatively easy to hold and throw both backhand and forehand. If you've wanted to throw a really fast driver, but couldn't quite handle the wide rim, try the Colossus. The GStar Colossus flight numbers have been updated to better reflect the less stable flight. (14/5/-2/3).

products.title: Star Gator Mid-Range
products.description: The Gator is a very reliable overstable Mid-Range disc with a predictable finish. The Gator delivers pin-point accuracy for shorter drives and approach shots, even in windy conditions. This is a great disc for Mid-Range shots especially for players who need to control their power and increase their accuracy.

products.title: Star Gorgon
products.description: Introducing the Gorgon, a disc that merges the feel, precision, and ease of a Fairway Driver with the reach of a Distance Driver. Its flight? Arrow-straight glide with a steadfast fade, mirroring the Gorgon's unwavering gaze. Experience the legend—drive like a deity, conquer the course.

products.title: Star Hawkeye
products.description: For predictability and accuracy in a fairway driver, grab the Innova Hawkeye. "This is a disc for staying on the fairway," says Innova co-founder and disc developer, Dave Dunipace. At faster speeds, it flies straight with exceptional glide. For players with less power, it has a consistent, mellow fade. All of this adds up to accuracy... the hallmark of the Hawkeye — Speed 7 | Glide 5 | Turn -1 | Fade 1.

products.title: Star IT
products.description: The Innova IT was developed to go straight and far, effortlessly. With ITs gentle turn and unmatched glide, tightly wooded fairways feel open and attackable. When another Fairway Driver would fade and drop, IT holds on the line of release and carries. Great for standstill and low ceiling shots that still need to get distance. IT also makes an exceptional roller disc, even when new.

products.title: Star Jay Mid-Range
products.description: A micro-beaded Mid-Range with a true-to-release flight, the Innova Jay will be a staple in bags everywhere. This all-purpose disc can handle power or be finessed. It has better torque-resistance than most Mid-Ranges, but still finishes straight. It is one of our most point-and-shoot discs on the market. The Jay’s low-profile design fits comfortably in your hand for a clean release every throw. Get yours in Champion and Star plastics today.

products.title: Star Katana
products.description: The Katana is built with the finesse thrower in mind. Recommended downwind driver. Hit the angle right and watch it bolt out of sight. The physical characteristics resemble a Boss with the flight characteristics of a Sidewinder on steroids. Master the technique of Katana and rule the course.

products.title: Star Katana - Holly Finley Tour Series
products.description: The Innova Katana in Star plastic (Holly Finley Tour Series). Built as an understable distance driver for easy hyzer-flips, long drifting turn with a strong, dependable fade — trustworthy into moderate wind. Speed 13 | Glide 5 | Turn -3 | Fade 3.

products.title: Star Leopard
products.description: The Leopard should be everyone’s first fairway driver as it is has excellent glide and is easy to throw straight and far. The Leopard is a great turnover disc for players of all skill levels. More experienced players can use the Leopard for throwing distance stretching “Hyzer Flip” shots. The Leopard makes a dependable long range roller — Speed 6 | Glide 5 | Turn -2 | Fade 1.

products.title: Star Mako3 - Kona Montgomery

products.title: Star Mamba
products.description: The Mamba has more high speed turn than any of our long range drivers, so throwing into a headwind is not recommended. For those with less driving speed, it will add distance. For the medium armed crowd, it will shape long lines for turnovers and straight shots, as well as hyzer flips and even big rolls — Speed 11 | Glide 6 | Turn -5 | Fade 1.

products.title: Star Orc
products.description: The Orc is one of our most popular, straight flying distance drivers. It combines speed with accuracy for very long range, predictable flights. Great for straight ahead power shots and long hyzer shots. Suitable for powerful throwers, but still manageable by beginners in lighter weights.

products.title: Star Racer
products.description: The Racer is a fast, stable long-range driver designed for players seeking maximum distance with a smooth fade. It offers performance similar to a seasoned Destroyer, making it ideal for those with max distance under 450 feet. The Racer provides excellent torque resistance, suitable for both sidearm and backhand drives.

products.title: Star Racer - First Run
products.description: The Racer is a fast, stable long-range driver designed for players seeking maximum distance with a smooth fade. It offers performance similar to a seasoned Destroyer, making it ideal for those with max distance under 450 feet. The Racer provides excellent torque resistance, suitable for both sidearm and backhand drives.

products.title: Star Rat Mid-Range
products.description: Players have asked for a forehand-specific approach disc and we’ve responded. Meet the Rat. It’s a low-profile, beadless mid-range that flies fast out of the hand. Add the flat top and the Rat could be the most comfortable sidearm approach disc around. Rip it forehand and it’ll fly straight with a predictable fade at the tail end. The backhand grip feels just as good with a flight just as predictable. Bonus: It’s a good option for headwind approach shots.

products.title: Star Roc3 - Joona Heinanen

products.title: Star RocX3 Mid-Range

We’ve given our legendary disc a low profile and a hefty rim to create extra control, making it the ideal Mid-Range for windy conditions and forehand throws. Power players will love the control. X-Factor fueled, the evolution continues. RocX3.

products.title: Star Rollo Mid-Range
products.description: Made famous by the man himself, Joseph Phillips, the Rollo is a utility, ultra-flippy disc. As the name suggests, the Rollo is a disc for rolling, but it can do so much more. Most people will find it easier to roll than just about any other disc. It's also an option for woods play to throw backhands around corner as it has a lot of turn and a lot of glide.

products.title: Star Shark
products.description: The Shark is the perfect mid-range disc for players of all skill levels. products.title: Star Shryke

products.title: Eclipse Vanish
products.description: We’ve got another stock addition ready for your glow bag! The Eclipse Vanish has been added to our catalog of stock offerings, now available all year long in our industry-leading glow plastic. An understable 11-speed distance driver, the Vanish excels at versatility with extremely workable straight and controlled turnover shots on a variety of release angles. Average-power throwers will get straight/understable flights in most conditions, as well as a long-range bomber in slight headwinds, while those with high power may prefer a tailwind or hyzer-flip shots. Head over to your favorite MVP dealer to get yours and start carving up the fairways with the Eclipse Vanish!

products.title: Neutron Time-Lapse - Special Edition (retooled)
products.description: New Time-Lapse, new Special Edition! Matthew Jorde brings us a typography-based stamp for the release of the Special Edition retooled Neutron Time-Lapse, adorning it with a clean style. The goal was to produce a stamp that was reminiscent of the first Time-Lapse SE, while still being its own thing - most fitting for a retool! Players will easily notice the difference between the original Special Edition Neutron Time-Lapse and this new retooled version, both by how it feels in the hand and its flight. Our goal for the Time-Lapse was to create a distance driver that high-power players would trust for controllable maximum distance, and lower-power players would appreciate for reliable and predictable flights. The retooled Time-Lapse is everything we wanted from the original run, and we are very excited about this one. Celebrate this achievement with Simon and MVP by grabbing your own Special Edition retooled Neutron Time-Lapse today!

products.title: Plasma Shift - St. Jude Fundraiser
products.description: As part of the 2024 MVP Open, the Streamline Shift debuted as a very special collaboration with St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital. Through sales of the Shift, our incredible disc golf community raised over $50,000 that has gone towards helping treat children with life-threatening cases. To kick off the MVP Open celebration a bit early, we’re announcing another collaboration with St. Jude for MVP Open 2025 - exclusively releasing the Plasma Shift for this extraordinary cause! Just like last year, MVP will be donating 60% of sales directly to St. Jude. This collaboration wouldn’t be complete without a stamp inspired by art created by a child receiving care from St. Jude, which industry veteran John Dorn has respectfully illustrated for this release. We deliberately chose the Shift as a disc that everyone can throw, because this cause is universal and affects us all - the more people throwing Shifts, the more support we can give to St. Jude. We hope you’ll join us in supporting St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital by purchasing one (or seven) of these Plasma Shifts for your own collection!

products.title: 2026 Gyropalooza Box
products.description: Our GYROpalooza boxes have always been loaded with quality discs at a fantastic price, and the added chance for them to contain one of one-hundred Golden Tickets inviting the holder to our in-person GYROpalooza celebration has only compounded on that goal. While you can expect the same incredible value once more, this year features something truly unique. Each box includes 11 discs: 4 GYROpalooza Special Edition discs with multi-foil stamps, 2 R2 Neutron discs, and 5 Lab Second discs. So what’s so unique? Read on to find out!MVP is pushing GYRO to the next level - introducing the Prototype GYRO-X Beam! Releasing with tentative flight numbers of 10 | 6 | -0.5 | 1 and an exceptional triple-foil GYROpalooza illustration from Matthew Jorde, the GYRO-X Beam is built from the ground up to be the next evolution in GYRO. There's been quite a few changes from previous prototypes of the Beam. This iteration has an ultra-lightweight Fission core, allowing for the lightest possible flight plate. The mold has also changed to be a more throwable 10 speed so a wider audience can fully enjoy GYRO-X. Lastly, and most importantly, there's a smaller but significantly more dense GYRO rim, complete with metallized weight filler. ﻿ ﻿ These changes move more weight than ever before to the outermost edge of the disc, allowing your throws to maintain spin, hold your line longer, and fly further. This change also allows for a high variety of weight classes, so all players can experience the exceptional flight of GYRO-X created by pushing The Leading Edge© past our limits. Releasing in 145-175g. This year we’re bringing the beef with the brand new MVP Neutron Mass! Debuting with an exclusive triple-foil GYROpalooza illustration from DoubleRam Design, the Mass is an overstable putter featuring the low-glide profile of discs like the Stasis and Range, but in a slightly faster speed class. With tentative flight numbers of 4 | 2 | 0 | 3, the Mass was developed for players who desire abundant stability from a putt and approach disc for increased landing zone accuracy. Releasing in 170-175g. We’re combining one of our most dazzling plastics with stable reliability for the MVP Particle Proton Control! With a triple-foil GYROpalooza illustration by Green C Studio, we get a glimpse of the controls behind some of MVP’s more unique visitors. Designed as an overstable 10-speed complement to the Trail, the Control remains reliable in headwinds, feels great in the hand, and now looks better than ever. Releasing in 170-175g. The Streamline Proton (Soft) Turbulence joins in as the final Special Edition for our 2026 GYROpalooza box, featuring another ghostly denizen of space (hey, they need discs too!) illustrated by Brent Schoonover. An overstable 7-speed disc, the Turbulence features a concave flight plate for clean, torque-resistant releases, and reduced glide for increased accuracy out on the fairway. Adding in the soft Proton plastic, this disc feels incredible in the hand and just might find a slot in your bag! Releasing in 170-175g.

products.description: The Ascend is here to lift your understable fairway game to new levels! With a speed of 6, glide of 5, turn of -3, and a fade of 0.5, the Ascend is a truly understable fairway driver designed for players of all skill levels. Players who are learning the game will love the Ascend’s easily attainable straight flights and, thanks to its glide, surprising distance for a fairway driver. Experienced and higher power players will appreciate the controllable turn the Ascend has to offer — allowing them to carve a lot of lines from hyzer angles and launch massive turnovers. With that easy flight, comfortable feel in the hand, and the tremendous Streamline Neutron plastic, the Ascend will find a place in any bag!

products.description: Speed 7 | Glide 5 | Turn -2 | Fade 1. The Drift is a fairway option for shaping a curve without adding a large finishing fade. Use its turning tendency for a sustained turnover, or begin on hyzer when you want a flight that rises toward flat. That combination makes it worth considering for wooded routes where the line matters more than maximum speed. Leave room for movement rather than expecting a fixed straight path.

products.title: Neutron Echo
products.description: Introducing the Neutron Echo midrange disc! With a slightly deeper hand feel than MVP’s midranges, the Echo is designed to fly straight with flight numbers of 5 | 5 | -1.5 | 1, providing you with reliable and predictable flight lines that make it an excellent choice for wooded disc golf. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a beginner just starting out, the Echo is capable of touch hyzer-flips and controlled turnovers for high power players, while lower power players will love its ability to fly straight with enough fade to serve as a reliable workhorse midrange and enough turn to work some anhyzer lines as well. With its absolutely buttery lines and feel, the Echo is the perfect addition to your disc golf bag.

As the understable complement to the Trace, the Jet fills a valuable niche for players of all arm speeds. Whether you’re looking for an easy-to-throw distance driver, or you love shaping lines from hyzer, the Jet is the driver for you!

products.title: Streamline Proton Shift - MVP Open / St. Jude Edition
products.description: For the 2024 MVP Open, we wanted to create something special to give back to the community. What better way than to release an unlimited, brand new mold - exclusive to the MVP Open - all in support of charity? And not just any charity either, 60% of MVP's sales from each disc sold will go directly to St. Jude Children’s Hospital and their fight against childhood cancer and other life-threatening diseases. It's our goal to hand St. Jude a big check at the MVP Open this year, and the brand new Streamline Proton Shift is how we're going to do that! This understable fairway driver is releasing with a unique illustration by Mike Inscho, taking heavy inspiration from art provided by a child receiving care from St. Jude. With flight numbers of 9/5/-3/1, it's a disc that anyone can throw and enjoy, for a cause that’s just as universal. We hope this MVP Open exclusive release is the start of a new and powerful tradition for the community, so please join us in supporting St. Jude Children’s Hospital by grabbing the brand new Streamline Proton Shift!.

The Goldilocks of our fairway lineup, uniting glide with a reliable fade; the Coalesce — Speed 9 | Glide 5 | Turn 0 | Fade 3.
